Card Q&A.q: Can I declare activation of this card's {Hand} [Main] effect even when I don't have [King Drasil_7D6] or [Mother Eater] in the breeding area?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. In order for the conditions for this card's {Hand} [Main] effect to be met, you must pay 3 cost and place this card as the bottom digivolution card of your [King Drasil_7D6] or [Mother Eater] in the breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: Can I pay 3 cost for this card's {Hand} [Main] effect but choose to not place this card as the bottom digivolution card of my [King Drasil_7D6] or [Mother Eater] in the breeding area?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect also trigger when this card itself is played?

Card Q&A.a: A {Breeding} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the breeding area. Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the breeding area.

Effect: {Hand} [Main] By paying 3 cost and placing this card as the bottom digivolution card of your [King Drasil_7D6] or [Mother Eater] in the breeding area, ＜Draw 1＞.

[All Turns] When any of your Digimon with the [Royal Knight] or [CS] trait are played, by suspending this Digimon, 1 of the played Digimon gains ＜Rush＞, ＜Raid＞, ＜Reboot＞ and ＜Blocker＞ until your opponent's turn ends.
Inherited Effect: {Breeding} [Start of Your Main Phase] If this Digimon has 6 or more digivolution cards, you may play 1 Digimon card with [King Drasil] in its name from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.
